description: The taxonomic name of the tree. Matching the stem measurement table.
The family name of the taxon.
The genus name of the taxon.
The specific epithet of the taxon. E.g. “africana” for species Burkea africana.
Wood density estimate from local field measurements, in g cm-3 to three decimal places.
Standard deviation of estimated wood density from multiple samples, in g cm-3 to three decimal places.
Number of individuals sampled to estimate wood density.
Classification of growth form. E.g. tree, bamboo, palm, grass-tree, liana, etc. See the GEO-TREES Tree Inventory Guidelines Section 7: What to measure.
Recommended above-ground woody biomass allometry e.g. “Chave et al. (2014) Equation 4”. Provide more details elsewhere.
